checks.name: Enemy activations disable player orders
Battle orders belong to the gameplay frame and leave every board cell unobstructed
Options can be closed with Escape and return keyboard focus
Three versus three loads with HP, teams and six initiative entries
Inspecting another unit never transfers the active turn
Attack preview and Escape cancellation preserve HP and resources
Blocked and unreachable movement reject without state changes
Attack then movement works once each and keeps the current initiative rolls
Movement then attack also works within one activation
Keyboard grid, visible focus, Enter and Escape complete the preview flow
A complete seeded battle reaches victory; defeated enemies leave cells and orders lock
Restarting the same seed reproduces the complete battle outcome and log
Waiting through player activations reaches defeat without stalled rounds
The result screen can restart a playable battle
Restarting during enemy thinking cancels obsolete scheduled turns
Intermediate and narrow layouts fit; an attack can be completed on the narrow layout
Movement trial and camp remain reachable as separate prototypes
Successful combat and prototype visits emit no JavaScript/console errors or external requests
Animated movement locks orders and resting animations support pause/resume
Slow loading gives progress and keeps commands disabled
Invalid/empty catalogue exposes a retry and recovers combat
A missing sprite becomes a movable marker; reload recovers it without JS errors
